description: Architecture guard of ddd-ts-kit: at session start, the next step of the plan, a one-line map per context and any gap between the version the skills describe and the installed packages; refuses hand-written generated files, the writing of the baseline of the errors by an agent, the code of a context in the main checkout of the trunk when the config requires worktrees and in a worktree of .worktrees/ without its own node_modules, writes of a context worker outside its bounded context, and its shell commands that write outside that context or change dependencies, stops it when its inline code changed a file outside it or run another formatter; checks each written file, after the Biome of the project laid it out when the config says formatOnWrite; lets a sub-agent only remove pending(...) in an acceptance test, lets the acceptance-judge agent alone write a verdict on a locked acceptance and refuses its lock to any hand edit; in the worktree of a story, refuses the code of a context until each row has its design review and the acceptance is written and locked, says the phase of the story and where it meets the other open stories at session start, says once per file when a write meets another story, and refuses once to end before its report; in the worktree of a fix, opens the code once the regression spec is locked and refuses every edit of that spec, by the editor tools and by the shell, to the session and its sub-agents; refuses to finish while architecture errors remain; reminds, without blocking, to commit a finished slice, and, in the worktree of a story, once when a done row departed from its design review without a compromise listed; warns a context-builder twice before its turn limit, records its runs in its worktree for `worker-scope --resume`, and at session start names the workers to resume. Fails open, no network.
